description: The diff viewer shows the commit message before the changed files load and keeps it selected. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a git repository whose last commit, "update story", changed story.txt. The server's answers to the diff viewer's changed-files requests (GET /api/git/diffs/<commit>/files?...) are held back until call "release"; call "files-requested" says whether one has arrived ("true" or "false"). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Open the Diffs tool: click the button with aria-label exactly "Diffs" in the header's workspace toolbar (".chat-workspace-actions"). 3. The overlay ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 4. Call "files-requested" until it returns "true". 5. The first "select.diff-viewer-select" in the overlay (the file select) should come to have a value starting with "commit-message:". 6. The overlay's ".diff-viewer-editor .editor.modified .view-lines" should contain the text "update story". 7. The file select must have exactly 0 options with value "story.txt" (option[value="story.txt"]). 8. Call "release". 9. The file select should come to have exactly 1 option with value "story.txt". 10. The file select's value should still start with "commit-message:".
